issue.title: just check symvision: unused public AuthenticatedFinalizerPlan/configured_instance_from_json/configured_instance_to_json in finalizers
issue.description: just check fails at lint (symvision) on a clean master checkout (verified via git stash on commit d88994bd8, no other changes applied) with: 'Unused public functions/classes... AuthenticatedFinalizerPlan in src/sase/finalizers/plan.py, configured_instance_from_json in src/sase/finalizers/config.py, configured_instance_to_json in src/sase/finalizers/config.py'. Discovered while running just check for an unrelated Admin Center Config tab rename (rename_config_misc_to_all). Likely introduced by a recent finalizers commit (e.g. 43f4538f8 'feat(finalizers): seal config snapshot into authority artifact and report live drift as diagnostics') or related finalizer work. These symbols should be made private if only used within their own file, deleted if unused, or added to the symvision epic whitelist if intentionally public for an in-progress epic (e.g. sase-rr 'Retire the pluggable finalizers beta and legacy controller' or sase-sp 'Make the commit declaration an authoring step, not a consent vote').

task_type_fields.impact: Blocks just check / just check-full for every agent touching src/sase, since the symvision gate runs whole-repo and fails before the test lane even starts.
task_type_fields.repro: On a clean master checkout run: SASE_SYMVISION_BEAD_STATUS_ONLY=1 BD_COMMAND=tools/sase_bead .venv/bin/symvision src/sase --exclude-decorator gate_command_entrypoint --exclude-decorator builtin_chop --epic-symbol "sase-n4(get_usage_limit_config)"  -- fails with the three unused-public-symbol errors above. Equivalently: just check (or just _lint-symvision).

payload.entry: Fixed during the sase-sp epic landing. The three symbols came from 43f4538f8 (seal config snapshot into authority artifact); none had a non-test consumer outside its own file. AuthenticatedFinalizerPlan is now _AuthenticatedFinalizerPlan (it is only named inside plan.py; controller.py and executor.py consume it by attribute access through the still-public authenticate_resolved_finalizer_plan_full), and its dead agent_meta_projection method — no caller anywhere, tests included — was deleted. configured_instance_to_json and configured_instance_from_json are now _-prefixed; both are used only by finalizer_config_to_json/from_json in the same file. All three dropped from their modules' __all__. just _lint-symvision is clean and the 364 finalizer tests pass.
